responsibility: Defines IA-64 OpenVMS-specific target options for the driver, currently providing the source-listing switch that is consumed by the VMS assembler spec. Its purpose is to extend the generated option tables with VMS-only command-line handling separate from the common IA-64 options in ia64.opt.
same_name_distinction: The VMS-specific option-definition companion to vms.h: unlike the header's ABI and toolchain macro overrides, this file only contributes VMS command-line option metadata for generated option tables, currently defining the driver-level source-listing switch consumed by the VMS assembler spec.
